title: Beyond Response Scoring: An AI-aware Cognitive Supervision Framework for Automated Mathematical Short Answer Grading
abstract: arXiv:2610.41215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer-based language models have achieved remarkable success in automated short answer grading (ASAG). However, current methods in ASAG struggle to comprehend, reason about and evaluate complex mathematical answers involving symbols and formulas. These score-only methods fail to generalize across diverse responses and skill states associated with identical scores. Moreover, they ignore the potential upward bias introduced by generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) usage in assessing students' performance and knowledge mastery. To address these limitations, we propose AICG (AI-aware Cognitive-supervised Grading), a two-branch multi-task framework. The first branch combines RoBERTa-based regression, ordinal, and classification heads for individual-answer grading. translated_title: 超越回答评分：面向自动数学简答题评分的AI感知认知监督框架
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的语言模型在自动简答题评分（ASAG）中取得了显著成功。然而，当前的ASAG方法难以理解、推理和评估涉及符号和公式的复杂数学答案。这些仅输出分数的方法无法在具有相同分数的不同回答和技能状态之间进行泛化。此外，它们忽略了生成式人工智能（AI）的使用在评估学生表现和知识掌握程度时可能引入的向上偏差。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了AICG（AI感知认知监督评分），这是一个双分支多任务框架。第一个分支结合了基于RoBERTa的回归、序数和分类头，用于对单个答案进行评分。第二个分支使用专家设计的Q矩阵将回答与所评估的技能相关联，并联合预测基于G-DINA的技能掌握度和学习增益。通过……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种双分支多任务框架AICG，将数学简答题评分与基于Q矩阵和G-DINA的认知诊断（技能掌握度与学习增益预测）相结合，并考虑生成式AI使用带来的评分偏差，以提升复杂数学答案自动评分的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AICG, a two-branch multi-task framework that combines automated grading of mathematical short answers with cognitive supervision (skill mastery and learning gain prediction via an expert-designed Q-matrix and G-DINA), while addressing the upward bias introduced by generative AI usage.
